zombies.name: Default
zombies.ability: Walks forward and eats plants.

zombies.name: cone head
zombies.ability: A normal zombie protected by a cone.

zombies.name: bucket head
zombies.ability: A normal zombie protected by a metallic bucket.

zombies.name: brick head
zombies.ability: A normal zombie protected by a heavy brick.

zombies.name: knight
zombies.ability: A normal zombie protected by crown and shoulder armor.

zombies.name: Gargantuar
zombies.ability: Instantly crushes plants and throws an Imp when reduced to half health.

zombies.name: Imp
zombies.ability: Moves and attacks faster than a normal zombie.

zombies.name: Ra
zombies.ability: Pulls nearby ground suns toward itself and steals them.

zombies.name: Explorer
zombies.ability: Uses a torch to instantly burn plants directly ahead; ice extinguishes the torch.

zombies.name: Tomb raiser
zombies.ability: Periodically creates graves on random empty tiles.

zombies.name: Dodo
zombies.ability: Flies over most blocking plants but cannot pass Tall-nut.

zombies.name: Hunter
zombies.ability: Periodically throws ice; a plant freezes after three hits.

zombies.name: Troglobite
zombies.ability: Pushes ice blocks that destroy plants on collision.

zombies.name: Fisherman
zombies.ability: Stays near the right side and periodically pulls a plant one tile right.

zombies.name: Octopus
zombies.ability: Periodically disables a plant with an octopus.

zombies.name: Snorkel
zombies.ability: Submerges in water and can only be damaged by lobbers while submerged.

zombies.name: Juggler
zombies.ability: Reflects direct projectiles while spinning and moves faster during the spin.

zombies.name: Wizard
zombies.ability: Turns plants into harmless cats until the Wizard dies.

zombies.name: King
zombies.ability: Stays still and periodically upgrades a nearby normal zombie into a knight.

zombies.name: Imp Dragon
zombies.ability: An Imp that is immune to fire damage.

zombies.name: Allstar
zombies.ability: Charges quickly, instantly destroys the first plant hit, then becomes slow.

zombies.name: Arcade
zombies.ability: Pushes an arcade cabinet that instantly destroys plants on collision.

zombies.name: Umbrella
zombies.ability: Deflects all lobbed attacks.

zombies.name: Turquoise
zombies.ability: Steals sun for five seconds, then destroys plants in four tiles ahead.

zombies.name: Prospector
zombies.ability: After ten seconds reverses direction and attacks from behind.

zombies.name: Piano
zombies.ability: Crushes plants and periodically shifts nearby zombies between lanes.

zombies.name: News Paper
zombies.ability: Becomes much faster after its newspaper armor is destroyed.
